Use this to group a firm's name variants under one display name without
editing code. Patterns are matched against the normalized provider name
key: upper-case, punctuation removed, common legal suffixes dropped.
So 'Smith & Jones Pension Services, LLC' has the key
'SMITH JONES PENSION' and would be matched by the pattern 'SMITH JONES'.
A pattern matches when it appears at the start of the key or as a whole
run of words within it. Keep patterns specific: a pattern of 'TRUST'
would sweep up hundreds of unrelated firms.
role is optional and only used as a hint when a filing names the provider
without saying what it does. Valid values are the ProviderRole names in
app/core/constants.py, for example RECORDKEEPER, TRUSTEE, CUSTODIAN,
